title: Fonio (Digitaria exilis and D. iburua) Controlled-Environment Research & Growth Manual: Standard Operating Procedures for Screenhouses, Greenhouses & Growth Chambers
content: Fonio (Digitaria exilis and D. iburua Kippist Stapf), commonly known as white fonio, fundi, or acha, is an ancient C4 cereal crop indigenous to West Africa. Renowned as one of the fastest-maturing cereals globally (60 - 90 days), fonio exhibits extraordinary drought tolerance and an exceptional amino acid profile rich in methionine and cysteine. Transitioning from traditional open-field broadcast systems to controlled environments (screenhouses, greenhouses, and precision growth chambers) enables year-round phenotyping, speed breeding, and disease evaluation.
